description: Deploy the current version of a builder WEB app to the customer's own hosting (Netlify or Vercel, their account). Only when the deploy checklist in builder_status is ready; the provider token, domain, env variables and secrets are entered in the dashboard, never through this tool. Costs builder credits (see prices in builder_status), given back when the deploy fails. Tell the person the cost, ask, and pass confirm: true. Follow the result with builder_status. Developer role. Pro and Team.
